ns2:course.label: Intermediate Bamana II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of BMNA 403; emphasis on ability to engage in reasonably fluent discourse in Bamana and comprehensive knowledge of formal grammar, and ability to read ordinary texts in standard Bamana. Participation in the language laboratory required. Same as AFST 404. 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: BMNA 403.
